comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: Can anyone tell what the requirements are for this treasure hunt theme to appear? It seems related to Italy/Rome and I expect we need to be in a specific world clock period..

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If I'm reading this google translation correctly, it looks like this relic's theme ("Italian Sword and Shield", with two relics that help fill out the No.4 TH album) will appear in 17th Century, phase 3 of the World Clock.

Source: sahryan.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-99.html

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Thanks for the great info!
Is that period even available at the moment? We can go to halfway of the 17th century, I think. Also the world clock is going to move to an earlier period, so no luck :(

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I believe it's possible. When Lion of the North launched, we started in 17th Century, phase 2:

Thirty Years' War

And phase 3's event is set immediately after that. It's also the very last historical event currently visible on the English portion of the DB:

Peace of Westphalia

Just think. If the clock had moved forward after Chapter 4 was first released, we'd already have this TH theme. Heh... well, in time, I'm sure we'll have them all unlocked.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: I was wondering about treasure hunts... if you use the final clue in a treasure hunt to accept the relic discovery quest, but then abandon the quest without finishing it, do you get the final clue piece for it back? Or is it gone for good? Sorry if I'm being a pest, I asked around elsewhere but nobody could tell me.

comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
Yes, when you use a clue to accept a quest(any clue) that clue is gone, even if it's a relic quest and you abandon the quests before discovering the relic. I found that out the hard way when I abandoned the quest for Uncle Hoca the first time by accident, and the clue still gone when I checked.

IGN: CullumStraun

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Eh, I figured that was going to be the case, but had to be sure. Many thanks for the answer!

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Even worse, after you abandon the TH quest, you can not use another final clue that day :)
